description: Calculator cores (FAM-27): frmSwingCalc CalcSwings, frmBSCalc CalcBS, frmCoinConvert CalcCoin and ConvertCoin, frmExpCalc CalcExp. Stock path only (bGreaterMUD false).
notes: The four procedures are cut out of their .frm files (scenario key frm, a list of forms). Their controls all resolve to the frmMain shim, so a case sets the calculator's controls under forms.frmMain; combo boxes hold the selected row in ListIndex and ItemData, radio buttons are Value true/false in an $array.

Outputs are the label and text box contents the procedure leaves behind; a control it did not write reads as the empty string. A VB error that escapes (CalcSwings has no handler) is the case's error field; one that MME handles is in events.

The 'table' case carries the Items, Classes and Races rows used (the Rust port never reads SQLite). 'sn-*' and 'pe-*' cases record GetSpellName and PullSpellEQ for the weapons' cast abilities (the port's CastText).

In swingfilt cases chkGlobalFilter is 1, so CalcSwings runs MME's PopulateCharacterProfile over the panel values in lblInvenCharStat/txtCharStats Tags; the Rust test builds the profile from the same values.
Rows numbered 9001 and up are invented (db_extra) to reach branches no stock row has.
